answer: Stop a gale of fake identities with expiring work receipts. An agent earns nectar only by finishing tasks that distinct, unrelated counterparties verify and sign, each receipt chained to the one before it, so a history cannot be bought or copied. After thirty days a receipt turns into a relic and stops counting toward earning power, so an attacker cannot stockpile old credit. A thousand fakes need a thousand separate chains of real verified service, each costing weeks of counterparty time — bulk creation buys nothing.
